eval.description: Google DeepMind deception eval from the dangerous-capabilities suite. A human answers quiz items with help from either an honest agent or an agent told to defend the wrong answer; the participant knows the mix and must probe for truth. Scoring is the percentage-point shift in belief in the correct answer before versus after the chat. Protocol is lab-held; each run needs new human participants.
eval.summary: Measures how far the model can persuade people to believe false answers during a chat.

scores.description: Percentage-point change in the participant's stated belief in the correct answer after talking to the agent.

metrics.description: Mean percentage-point belief shift. Cards split honest-agent and dishonest-agent conditions.
